title.ja: GN・LMと有界最小二乗のBratu比較
title.en: Bratu comparisons of GN, LM and bounded least squares

summary.ja: 同じ観測からの17固定fitで、変数尺度・重み・境界と物理座標の停止条件を分けます。
summary.en: Seventeen fixed fits separate parameter scaling, weights, bounds and physical-coordinate stopping conditions.

assumptions.ja: 無次元1D Bratu、31内点、u(0)=u(1)=0。既存の2係数モデルと保存済み観測を再利用。正則化γとLM減衰μを別に扱います。
assumptions.en: A dimensionless one-dimensional Bratu problem with 31 interior nodes and zero Dirichlet data. The existing two-coefficient extension and saved observations are reused; objective regularization gamma and LM damping mu are distinct.

algorithm.ja: 独自SVD最小二乗GN/LM、元の投影勾配、SciPy TRF、非有界SciPy LM。lower/upperベクトルを元PGの係数別区間へ明示変換。
algorithm.en: Original SVD least-squares GN/LM, the retained projected-gradient solver, SciPy TRF and explicitly unbounded SciPy LM. A canonical lower/upper box is explicitly adapted to the legacy per-parameter intervals.

validation.ja: 独立Thomas状態・感度と4局所参照fit。最終状態残差、物理勾配または投影勾配、目的値差、データのみのSVD、活性境界を検査。非有界法の共通参照は内点かつ非有界停留が条件です。
validation.en: Independent Thomas states/sensitivities and four local reference fits. Gate final state residuals, physical gradient or projected gradient, objective gaps, data-only SVD and active bounds. Common references for unbounded methods must be strictly interior and unbounded-stationary.

limits.ja: 小さい滑らかな分枝の局所比較。SciPy最適化ライブラリは参照側でも共有し、大域最小・一意性を証明しません。LMに箱制約があるとは説明しません。
limits.en: A local comparison on a small smooth branch. The optimizer library is shared by the reference and a companion; no global minimum or uniqueness proof is claimed. LM is not presented as a box-constrained method.

references.review_scope: Parameters, bounds, callable Jacobian, method-specific ftol/xtol/gtol and x_scale, max_nfev, returned status and Notes on LM and TRF. LM does not handle bounds and requires at least as many residual rows as variables; TRF supports bounds. MINPACK/STIR original papers were not read in this preparation.

caption.en: Saved two-parameter iterates and residual evaluations. SciPy paths include residual evaluations, not only accepted iterates; these are parameter coordinates, not a two-dimensional physical flow.

title.en: BFGS and three-pair L-BFGS at known minima

summary.ja: 8次元SPD二次関数と3初期値のRosenbrockを用い、曲率・strong Wolfe・現在の有限記憶作用を検査します。
summary.en: An eight-dimensional SPD quadratic and three Rosenbrock starts test curvature, strong Wolfe conditions and the current finite-memory action.

assumptions.ja: 無次元の非有界代数的最適化。既知の解析最小点を持ち、物理PDEの境界条件はありません。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless unconstrained algebraic optimization with known analytic minima; there is no physical PDE boundary condition.

algorithm.ja: 独自逆BFGSとベクトルだけの2-loop L-BFGS（3組）。独立な小稠密oracleは現在γ₀Iから現在保持する組だけを古い順に再生。SciPy BFGS/L-BFGS-B（bounds=None）を別実装として比較。
algorithm.en: Original inverse-BFGS and vector-only two-loop L-BFGS with three pairs. A separate small dense oracle replays only currently retained pairs from the current gamma0 I. SciPy BFGS and unbounded L-BFGS-B are distinct software companions.

validation.ja: 16固定fit、解析的な最小点・勾配、各受理stepのstrong Wolfeと解像された正曲率、BFGSの対称SPD、L-BFGS作用差を判定。保持組とoracle稠密行列の記憶を分離。
validation.en: Sixteen fixed fits check analytic minima/gradients, strong Wolfe and resolved positive curvature at every accepted step, symmetric SPD BFGS matrices and L-BFGS action defects. Retained-pair and dense-oracle storage are reported separately.

limits.ja: 厳密線形探索ではないためn反復終了や一般的Rosenbrock大域収束を主張しません。原著選択箇所は弱Wolfeであり、本例のstrong Wolfeと区別。Fletcher1970本文は未読です。
limits.en: No exact n-step termination or general global convergence on Rosenbrock is claimed. The selected original text uses weak Wolfe, distinct from this study’s strong Wolfe policy. Fletcher’s 1970 original article remains unread.

title.ja: 雑音・モデル差と有限γ経路の正則化
title.en: Noise, model discrepancy and finite gamma paths

summary.ja: 2独立ノイズベクトルを尺度・データ文脈で共有し、42固定fitから有限γ選択と固定γの局所共分散を分けます。
summary.en: Two independent noise vectors are reused across scales and data contexts. Forty-two fixed fits separate finite-list gamma selection from fixed-gamma local covariance.

assumptions.ja: Bratu推定は31内点、5観測、W=I/5、Σ=σ²I。既存1023格子のデータは保存値を使い再生成しません。σ=1e-4/1e-3、seed67001/67002、γの固定5点です。
assumptions.en: Bratu inference uses 31 interior nodes, five observations, W=I/5 and Sigma=sigma² I. Existing 1023-grid observations are reused without regeneration. Fixed sigma values are 1e-4/1e-3, seeds are 67001/67002 and the gamma list has five entries.

algorithm.ja: 全γのfitを資格した完全経路だけから、実現雑音ノルムの1.05倍を満たす最大γを選択。不完全経路と完全だが候補なしを分離。4点L-curveは記述診断。
algorithm.en: Select the largest admissible gamma using 1.05 times the realized noise norm only after the full gamma path qualifies. Incomplete paths and complete paths with no admissible gamma are distinct. Four-point L-curves are descriptive diagnostics.

validation.ja: 42 fitの最終残差・物理KKT・実行完了、選択規則、明示的2×2代数による固定線形モデルの共分散・偏り・モデル差応答、対称PSDを検査。
validation.en: Gate final residuals, physical KKT conditions and completion for all 42 fits, the selection rule, and covariance/bias/model-shift response against explicit scalar 2x2 algebra, including symmetry and PSD.

limits.ja: 楕円は選択γを固定した局所Gauss–Newton線形モデルのplug-inです。非線形残差の二階微分、γ選択のランダム性、選択事象で条件づけた共分散、事後分布、被覆率を扱いません。全γ連続経路・実測データも未検証。
limits.en: Ellipses are plug-in noise propagation for a local Gauss–Newton linear model with the selected gamma treated as fixed. They omit nonlinear residual Hessians and selection randomness and are not selection-conditional covariance, a posterior or a coverage guarantee. Continuous gamma paths and real data remain unverified.

references.title: Regularization Tools, Version 4.1 for Matlab 7.3
references.review_scope: Official author manual: selected text around Section 2.5 and Section 2.9; physical pages 20 and 37 (printed 18 and 35) rendered locally and visually inspected. L-curve residual/solution norm tradeoff and discrepancy equation (2.61) were read. Four-point chord curvature here is a finite-list diagnostic, not the manual spline/corner algorithm, a theorem of optimal regularization or coverage. Original software (1994) and later article (2007) are separate bibliographic works and were not read.
